specs.title: @public @map Hindi missing-data state never invents an India outline
@public @map client-only vector map joins recorded zero and safe text with table alternative
@phase11 original media is lazy, captioned, controllable and absent under reduced motion
@phase11 savings-first grouping and last-updated expire offline without hydration or hidden ticks
@phase11 data screens expose loading empty offline error states at 360px with measured axe results
